$comment: W3-09 recorded call (W3-02's format, extended): start, routes (field-api's recorded answers per voice route, in order; the last repeats), reporterTurns (one session run each), agentTurns (the dialog model's recorded turns). `extraction` names the eval case (fixtures/transcripts, expected, tool-outputs) whose recorded tool output EXTRACT_PROVIDER=fake replays for this call's update_draft; `answers` are the reporter's words record_answer sends. The worker's PGlite test (apps/worker/src/jobs/voice-turn.pglite.test.ts) checks that the live pipeline answers what `routes` records (ids aside); the agent's pytest (tests/test_live_draft.py) replays the call on FakeFieldApi. W3-15: `simulate` is this call as `pnpm simulate:call` runs it on a local stack (scripts/src/call-sim): the org it arranges, the requests the agent sends in order (`$…` values from the call so far; `recorded` = the route's next recorded answer above, pending ones skipped, ids aside) and what the call leaves behind. W4-07: F14 in Turkish: a reporter of two sites (Kartal and Ataşehir) by phone, the site question asked in the opening, Kartal picked, the hero report filed on evet. No `simulate` block: the TR pack has no voice number until a Turkish number is set up (§19 Q2, W4-14), so `pnpm simulate:call` cannot dial it, and a Talk now call always names its site (the field app's switcher is F14 there); the agent's replay (tests/sim) runs it on FakeFieldApi.
